query: INSERT INTO source_activity AS a (source_id, day, batches, requests, tool_calls, duplicates, refused) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7) ON CONFLICT (source_id, day) DO UPDATE SET batches = a.batches + excluded.batches, requests = a.requests + excluded.requests, tool_calls = a.tool_calls + excluded.tool_calls, duplicates = a.duplicates + excluded.duplicates, refused = a.refused + excluded.refused
